name: 11_tie_rope
title: Tying Box and Arranging Flowers
summary: The robot ties a red rope around a gift box, pans away to adjust a flower vase, and returns to inspect the tied box.
robot: two black robotic arms with parallel grippers
setting: a dining room with a grey table and a flower vase

source.original_prompt: Tie the rope with both hands

segments.instruction: Cross the ends of the red rope tightly over the top of the box.
Pull the rope ends through to tighten the knot securely against the box.
Pick up the tied box with both grippers and move it to the left side of the table.
Release the box and turn the head camera to the right toward the flower vase.
segments.memory_event: hide: the tied box on the left leaves the camera frame as the camera turns right

segments.instruction: Reach forward with the right gripper and gently adjust the flower vase on the table.
Release the vase, retract both grippers slightly, and keep the camera focused on the flowers.
Turn the head camera back to the left side of the table.
segments.memory_event: return: the tied box reappears on the left side of the table, exactly where it was placed

segments.instruction: Reach toward the tied box with both grippers to inspect it.
